description: Cucumber is a fast-growing annual vine cultivated for its edible fruits, commonly trained on trellises or allowed to sprawl in vegetable gardens. It thrives in warm climates and is widely used in kitchen gardens and small-scale landscape edible beds.
common_diseases: Powdery mildew, Downy mildew, Cucumber mosaic virus, Aphids
care_water: Requires consistent moisture; water deeply 2–3 times per week, keeping soil evenly moist but not waterlogged. Mulching helps retain soil moisture and reduce evaporation.
care_sunlight: Full sun is essential, requiring at least 6–8 hours of direct sunlight daily for optimal flowering and fruiting.
care_soil: Prefers well-drained, fertile loamy soil rich in organic matter with pH 6.0–7.0. Good drainage is critical to prevent root rot.
care_maintenance: Apply balanced fertiliser every 2–3 weeks during the growing season. Prune excess vines lightly to improve air circulation and remove diseased foliage promptly.

description: Potato is a herbaceous perennial grown as an annual for its underground tubers, forming bushy foliage above ground. It is widely cultivated in temperate regions and suitable for raised beds or agricultural plots.
common_diseases: Late blight, Early blight, Potato scab, Colorado potato beetle
care_water: Maintain evenly moist soil, watering 1–2 times per week depending on rainfall; avoid waterlogging but prevent drought during tuber formation.
care_sunlight: Requires full sun with at least 6–8 hours of direct light daily for strong vegetative growth and tuber development.
care_soil: Grows best in loose, well-drained sandy loam soil with pH 5.0–6.5. Soil should be friable to allow tuber expansion and good drainage.
care_maintenance: Hill soil around stems as plants grow to encourage tuber formation. Apply balanced fertiliser at planting and during early growth; remove diseased foliage and rotate crops annually.
